name: Holostep: 3D viewer
author: Erik Grof

sections.description:
✨ 3D/AR VIEWER PLATFORM | 🚀 NO-CODE SOLUTION | 🔥 TURN YOUR VISITORS INTO CUSTOMERS

Start your 3D viewer journey

Boost your website’s conversion and engagement rates effortlessly with our 3D/AR viewer.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on third-party services to deliver its functionality. It communicates with the following external services:

  1. Holostep API
    The plugin sends data to Holostep’s API to connect your WordPress site to your Holostep account.

    • Service URL: https://api.holostep.io/api/v1/app/wordpress/connect
    • Privacy Policy: https://3d.holostep.io/privacy-policy

  2. Holostep Script Loader
    The plugin loads scripts from Holostep’s script service to display the 3D and AR viewer on your website.

    • Service URL: https://onsite-scripter.holostep.io/serve/core.js
    • Privacy Policy: https://3d.holostep.io/privacy-policy

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms of use and privacy policies of these third-party services.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

Absolutely not. Holostep is designed with high performance and compatibility in mind. We’re loading our viewer and scripts asynchronously.

Do I need coding skills to use the 3D viewer?

No, we are a no-code platform. We want it to keep it that way.
